title.zh: Robinhood Reports $15B in Stock Token Trading as Chain Passes 100 Days
title.en: Robinhood Reports $15B in Stock Token Trading as Chain Passes 100 Days

current_state.zh: Robinhood says its stock tokens have crossed $15 billion in cumulative trading volume with 200,000 holders as its chain passes 100 days, while Morpho's dashboard shows about $1.1 billion deposited on the network.
